correctness.rationale: Every initial wall persists. The bounded intervals between walls erode by two, producing a permanent missing wall for even initial interior runs; zero boundary runs erode one-sided, and one boundary runs form a permanent defect precisely at even lengths at least four. These mechanisms prove a necessary and sufficient all-length basin language. A run decomposition gives the exact generating function; partial fractions yield Fibonacci/Lucas formulas and parity asymptotics. An independent finite functional-graph enumeration of 524280 states for lengths 3..18 and exact arithmetic recurrence through length100 agree.

value.rationale: The most spatially alternating Rule 178 oscillator is a canonical recurrent target. Its exact attraction probability measures the global selection of a specific orbit, rather than counting attractors. A nontrivial boundary-sensitive forbidden-run language yields an explicit full-length rational generating function and two distinct parity constants, proving exponential rarity of this oscillator amid overwhelmingly oscillatory initial states. This naturally motivated basin invariant is not given by the prior total-orbit and transient counts.
